https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BK7qeKzd8hk

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468470/Soulbind_Tales_Of_The_Underworld/

notes.title: Palace Square
notes.content:
Hello Steam community
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BK7qeKzd8hk

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468470/Soulbind_Tales_Of_The_Underworld/
 
Biom: Дворцовая площад
Locations

Outskirts of the palace
Castle
Palace crypt

Dark world does not mean a world without beauty. Before the War of Gods, huge palaces, squares, gardens and dungeons served as dwellings for the higher castes of Allaar. Now these places are abandoned by their creators and they are inhabited by those who do not care about beauty, but do care about destruction. On the Palace Square, the remains of its former grandeur are still visible, but every year these beauties fade more.

notes.title: Out of early access after exactly one year
notes.content:
Hello Steam community! 

This is the developer of Soulbind: Tales Of Underworld, Arylhan from Rubedo Games. In the last few months, finalizing the game from a pet project has turned into a solo development. Yes, I was not able to realize everything I had planned, but I was able to master Unity. But still I am glad that I was able to complete this chapter of my life, and in the future, if it turns out to develop a new game, I have a prototype of one game and the concept of another, I will have to choose. 

Small bugs still remain, so I will fix them little by little.

 Best wishes,  
Arylkhan from Rubedo Games.

notes.content:
Hello Steam community
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BK7qeKzd8hk

Name: Seth-Salen.
Type: location boss, anthropomorphic.
Habitat: palace square
Abilities: cleaver strike, cleaver throw, devour, summon spikes and skulls

Centuries ago, Seth-Salen joined a cult that worshipped the ancient dead god Eluu. The followers of the cult created a vast amount of energy with their prayers to revive Eluu, but Seth-Selen took advantage of that energy. He absorbed some of that power, but it transformed him, making him a fallen demon, changing his body and enslaving his mind. Now this mountain of rotting flesh, eaten by maggots, attacks anyone who comes near. Could Eluu have been reborn in him?

notes.content:
Hello Soulbind community
Today we have a story about a cute manticore cat named Arsan.
Name: Arsan
Type: manticore ( mom is a cat, dad is a scorpion )
Habitat: sewers, library
Abilities: poison projectile, rush attack.

Arsan is a manticore. He loves sewers due to the abundance of rats in them. Their abundance in libraries is due to their love of reading books. 
Archie's records hold information like this: 
Arsans are one of the youngest races of the world. They are armed with a tail capable of firing poisonous projectiles, a powerful body and cunning. Some creatures worship them as deities, so the Arsans were able to reach the Western lands, plunder many places and found a city called Dungeon that couldn’t be conquered either by might or magic.
We are always open to your feedback and suggestions to improve the game.

notes.title: Story Narrator Soruk
notes.content:
Hello Soulbind community
Today we're going to tell you about a narrator named Soruk, one of the central characters of Soulbind: Tales of the Underworld.
Soruk has mastered the art of flesh resurrection, but does not tell the whole world about his knowledge. Traditionally neutral, Soruk doesn't try to become the head of Allaar, although there is a feeling that he can easily do this if he wants to. notes.title: The new update is now available!
The demo is available to players again!
notes.content:
The new update to version 0.9.9 is available for players, the following changes have been made:


 Optimized the size of the altar and gate badge;
 Improved the Stone Skin ability;
 Fixed ropes;
 Fixed the layers on the character doll in the altar window;
 Removed shards in the HUD;
 Added trap damage to mobs.
.

We have also released a demo version and in connection with this we are holding a Giftaway keys.

Conditions:

 Make a video recording of the passage from the start of the level
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44272279/603b128c238d9b66dd4e7f2174672034308dd200.png
 
To the end of the level (gate)

2 nominations: 

 Speedrun - for running through the level without getting into fights; 
 Sweep - for destroying all mobs and trap rooms.
